headline: Bystander who killed Oregon shooter identified as father of girls at elementary school

members.title: Police search for clues to deadly shooting at Oregon elementary school
members.lead: Schools closed after one teacher and three children killed, and child and teacher hospitalized with critical injuries Oregon elementary school shooting: what we know so far Police are investigating a deadly shooting at an elementary school in Bend, Oregon, where a 16-year-old opened fire on Thursday, killing three children and a teacher, before being shot dead by an armed bystander. Authorities in Oregon said that the three children killed at Silver Rail elementary school were aged five, eight and 11, and that a seven-year-old child and a 54-year-old teacher were also hospitalized with critical injuries. Continue reading...

members.title: Bystander who killed Oregon shooter identified as father of girls at elementary school
members.lead: Kaylub Giamanco, who was reportedly driving home when he heard gunshots, ‘not seeking recognition’, family says Details are beginning to emerge about Kaylub Giamanco, the man who brought the deadly shooting at elementary school in Bend, Oregon on Thursday, to an end by fatally shooting the 16-year-old suspect in the midst of a violent rampage. Authorities have yet to officially release the man’s identity, but Kaylub Giamanco’s family issued a statement on Friday confirming that he shot and killed the suspect. Continue reading...
